text: {"lessons":["My account is up overall, but that alone does not show whether I beat the market; I should compare performance over a meaningful period and include risk.","Adding Stock C at a much higher price taught me not to chase momentum: I should buy more only when the case still holds and the position fits my plan.","My sales of B at a loss and D at a gain remind me to define risk and exit criteria in advance, rather than letting emotions or average cost drive decisions."]}
